children: A White House spokesperson said on Friday US President Donald Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the end of his trip to China next week.
Trump will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons during the meeting, a spokesperson said.
"We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement," a US official said.
